_readme: Copy to panel.json and keep your own rails. Secrets live in the environment ONLY; no key ever belongs in this file. 'family' is what quorum counts - two rails with the same family are two doors to one opinion. Model tier is not a budget knob: the flash/lite tier spends its budget on reasoning and returns nothing, which silently shrinks your quorum (gotcha 20) - smartest model per family, effort medium.

rails._comment: Local CLI rails: disabled by default because they need their own login. Enable the ones you actually have - and if you hold a flat subscription for one of these families, enable it and drop that family's http rail above, or you are paying a gateway for a bucket you already own (gotcha 21). {prompt_file} is replaced with a temp file holding the prompt - never pass a multi-line prompt as an argv string.
rails.name: codex
